title: Research: audit PR #2575's owner evacuation and prove its unique power-cost crossover
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independently certify the fixed PR2575 owner evacuation against PR2530, and prove the exact range where it lowers the recursive rank bill. Both 281,052-role allocations pass the literal window, width, family and slice constraints. The evacuation moves 547 whole-helper occurrences between bins, changes 694 role descriptors and 462 residual ranks, preserves rank mass, and adds 56 positive-rank children.

For `F(p) = sum_r (H2575[r]-H2530[r])*r^p`, there is exactly one zero in `0<p<1`, with `0.289994 < p_* < 0.289995`. The new rank bill is strictly lower for `p_*<p<1`, and strictly higher below `p_*`. The initial all-exponent-dominance question is therefore answered negatively; the useful completed result is the exact crossover classification. This does not identify an error in PR2575's stated endpoint.

The proof uses the signed hinge function `sum d_r min(r,t)`, its single sign change at `57/29`, and a strictly decreasing normalized integral. Rational logarithm/Taylor enclosures certify the bracket signs. No floating-point sign decision or approximate root is an acceptance condition.

Only `research/t74-evacuation-power-audit/` is added. This is a finite allocation certificate and scoped analytic proof. No new supplier, endpoint, κ, optimizer minimum, selected-frontier change or full multiplication theorem is claimed. Native dirty-state/phase replay, physical chart realization, complete movement/precision charges and outer admission remain inherited and unchecked here.

## Validation

Passed on CPython 3.12.3 / Linux x86_64, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-evacuation-power-audit
python3 -I -O -B research/t74-evacuation-power-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-evacuation-power-audit --check-only
```

Expected primary output:

```text
PASS_T74_EVACUATION_POWER_AUDIT roles_per_map=281052 changed_bins=462 crossover=(0.289994,0.289995) controls=9
```

The primary replay reconstructs all 1,332 physical windows from 2,220 per-replica events, including 666 bridges, and checks all eleven emitted owner fields. Nine controls reject missing/ill-typed roles, invalid offsets/windows, family aliasing, overlapping slices, prefix holes, reversed cost direction and lost rank mass. Reversed row order preserves the result; independent integer square roots corroborate the interval evaluator.

The registered integrity check passes source-byte mutation, JSON value-type mutation, exclusive-output refusal and a Git-free read-only export, with all exported bytes unchanged. All 19 vendored files were also compared directly with their exact upstream Git objects. Metadata/source pins and staged whitespace checks pass. Ordinary replay writes no tracked files; receipt regeneration refuses existing outputs.

Not run: the predecessor's full native/supplier/outer cold replay, physical Clifford/projector checks, full precision/stock/bit-side admission, Lean, hosted CI or independent human review. The proof is a written analytic argument with exact finite hypotheses, not a proof-assistant theorem.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json identify two bounded follow-ups: test one legal same-word evacuation whose signed hinge function is nonpositive at every knot, or compare an existing alternative spectrum while keeping words and order exactly fixed. These would distinguish uniform concave-cost dominance from optimization at one exponent. Both need an actual legal replacement and source-bound allocation checks before any full supplier or κ claim.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The overlap helper, exclusive handoff reservation and source-word equality checks made a distinct central audit feasible. A short machine-readable list of changed owner bins and explicitly intended exponent range would make evacuation submissions easier to compare.
